title: p2a positive arms re-run with the PRE-REGISTERED structural G1 and a corrected distance convention
one_line: p2a's positive arms were VOID under G1 because the runner's structural mask check crashed on a misspelled kwarg and silently fell back to an invalid behavioural probe. p2b fixes the instrument and re-runs arms 1-2 only. The negative arms 3-4 passed their gates and are NOT re-run.

root_cause_of_p2a_void.bug1_structural_check_crashed: run_p2a.py called transformers.masking_utils.create_causal_mask(input_embeds=..., cache_position=...). In transformers 5.14.1 the parameter is `inputs_embeds` and `cache_position` is not accepted -> TypeError on every arm -> silent fallback to the behavioural probe. Verified by reproducing the exact call this tick.
root_cause_of_p2a_void.bug2_wrong_mask_function: Even spelled correctly, create_causal_mask is the FULL-attention mask constructor; Phi-3/Mistral route sliding layers through create_sliding_window_causal_mask (modeling_phi3.py:403, modeling_mistral.py:372). The structural check must use the sliding constructor.
root_cause_of_p2a_void.bug3_behavioural_probe_invalid: The fallback perturbed position 0 and required logit delta < 1e-3 at the final position. With an ENFORCED per-layer window, stacked layers still relay information (receptive field = layers x W), so a nonzero delta is expected and does not indicate an unenforced mask. This is why windowed models showed LARGER deltas than the windowless control while still cliffing within 16 tokens of W - the tension p2a's decision.json recorded.
root_cause_of_p2a_void.verified_this_tick: create_sliding_window_causal_mask(config=phi3_cfg(eager), inputs_embeds=..., attention_mask=..., past_key_values=None) returns a [1,1,T,T] float16 tensor with mask[i, i-W-1] = -65504 (blocked), mask[i, i-W] = -65504, mask[i, i-1] = 0 (visible). The window IS structurally applied by this install's eager path.

distance_convention_change.p2a_convention: distance = query_position - needle_START. The VALUE token sits ~6-9 tokens after needle start, so at recorded d = W+4 the value token is still INSIDE the window. This exactly predicts p2a's observed step in (W+4, W+16] and its G3 calibration misses (+0.125/+0.104, observed EXCEEDS predicted).
distance_convention_change.p2b_convention: distance = query_position - index of the LAST value token, computed at construction by tokenizing needle head, value, and tail separately. Under this convention the inclusive-mask law (p1d) predicts recall intact at d = W and chance at d >= W+1.
distance_convention_change.both_recorded: Each probe records distance_value_token (gated) AND distance_needle_start (p2a-comparable, descriptive only).

design.task: identical to p2a: needle retrieval in FineWeb-Edu filler, distance recorded at generation, never inferred
design.reps_rationale: p2a's only G2 violations were 3/24 and 2/24 single far strata; 48 reps halves the standard error there. Registered before launch.
design.strata: same shape as p2a: dense at W-256,W-64,W-16,W-4,W-1,W,W+1,W+4,W+16,W+64,W+256 plus sparse 64..max_context-256, all in VALUE-TOKEN distance
design.chance: measured by the same no-needle negative control battery, n = 4 x reps
design.hardware: local V100 (cuda:0), evaluation only, models already in HF cache, no cloud spend

preregistered_gates.G0_capability: recall >= 0.90 at d < 256 (value-token distance). Failure => INCONCLUSIVE for that model.
preregistered_gates.G1_window_enforced_STRUCTURAL: create_sliding_window_causal_mask (the constructor the model's own forward uses) must return a materialized mask for seq_len = W+64 with: mask[i, i-W-1] blocked AND mask[i, i-1] visible. mask[i, i-W] is recorded descriptively (inclusive vs exclusive boundary). NO behavioural fallback is accepted: if the mask API is unreachable or returns None, the arm is VOID. The three mask values are recorded verbatim in result.json.
preregistered_gates.G2_cliff: recall >= 0.90 at all strata d <= W-16, AND recall <= p_chance_measured + 0.05 at all strata d >= W+16 (value-token distance).
preregistered_gates.G3_calibration: |aggregate_recall - (f + (1-f) * p_chance_measured)| <= 0.05, f = fraction of battery probes at d <= W (value-token distance).
preregistered_gates.G4_boundary_descriptive: report recall at W-1, W, W+1, W+4, W+16; per p1d the inclusive-mask prediction is intact at d = W and chance at d >= W+1. Descriptive, never gates.
preregistered_gates.pass_if: G0 and G1 and G2 and G3, per model independently

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.both_pass: LAW_TRANSFERS_TO_DEPLOYED_MODELS (the p2a outcome that G1's instrument fault blocked).
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.one_passes_one_fails: PARTIAL - report both, no averaging; differences become a new campaign.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.capable_but_no_cliff: LAW_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER - reported first and unhedged; p1c/p1d unaffected but restated as from-scratch-only.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.G1_fails_structurally: VOID for that arm - and since the structural check was verified working before launch, a G1 failure now means the mask really is not applied, which is itself reportable.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.note: Fixed before any probe of p2b was scored. p2a's gates stay failed as written; nothing in p2a is amended. p2b is a new campaign with a fixed instrument, per standing rule 4.

operator: archlab autonomous operator (headless tick), handling p2a decision per marker protocol. Evaluation-only, local V100s, no spend.
